definitions.explanation: A Japanese hot pot dish featuring thinly sliced beef simmered in a sweet soy sauce broth (warishita) along with vegetables, tofu, and noodles. Pieces are typically dipped in beaten raw egg before eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すき{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
すき{焼|や}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}き{卵|たまご}につけて⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: You dip the sukiyaki meat in beaten egg and eat it.

examples.english: In winter, I look forward to the whole family gathering around the pot for sukiyaki.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTES: A popular winter dish and a celebratory meal. The ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧ style uses a pre-mixed sauce called ⟦{割|わ}り{下|した}→割り下：10039_warishita⟧ (warishita), while the ⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧ style cooks the meat first by searing it with sugar and soy sauce directly in the pan.

Common ingredients include ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧ (beef), ⟦{豆腐|とうふ}→豆腐：04928_toufu⟧ (tofu), ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧ (napa cabbage), {長|なが}ネギ (green onion), ⟦しらたき→しらたき：07480_shirataki⟧ (shirataki noodles), and {春菊|しゅんぎく} (garland chrysanthemum).
